name: Quadriceps Muscle Strain
definition: Acute strain of quadriceps musculature, commonly rectus femoris, caused by sprinting, kicking or forced stretch.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; MRI/ultrasound is used for severe or atypical injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Major proximal rectus femoris avulsion may need specialist review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Mamsa/Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Acute strain of quadriceps musculature, commonly rectus femoris, caused by sprinting, kicking or forced stretch.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
